note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Screens that mix a terminal and a portal carry the second half in also[] (when = before/after the main part). Scenes read MG_LAB_ADMIN_UPN / MG_LAB_DOMAIN (set by prepare, derived from the signed-in labadmin).
prepare: Connect-MgGraph -Scopes LicenseAssignment.Read.All, User.Read.All, AuditLog.Read.All, RoleManagement.Read.Directory, LicenseAssignment.ReadWrite.All, User.ReadWrite.All -NoWelcome  # owner signs in (browser)
# trial SKU names come from the tenant, not from memory

$c = Get-Content ./src/licensing.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $c.inactivity.inactiveDays = 3; $c.inactivity.neverSignedInGraceDays = 0; $c.prices.perUserPerMonth = [pscustomobject]@{ SPE_E5 = 50 }; if ($dyn) { $c.prices.perUserPerMonth | Add-Member -NotePropertyName $dyn.skuPartNumber -NotePropertyValue 0; $c.reclaim.allowedSkuPartNumbers = @($dyn.skuPartNumber) }; $c | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Set-Content ./src/licensing.lab.json   # the prices are examples, not Microsoft's and not what the lab pays
# one disabled account for real: taylor.demo (sign-in blocked, licences stay); re-enabled in teardown

./src/Invoke-LicensingOptimization.ps1 -ConfigFile ./src/licensing.lab.json -SaveSnapshot ./src/snapshot.lab.json -OutFile ./src/audit.lab.md   # off-camera dry run: signInActivity present, labadmin not in the plan

screens.name: licences
steps: Billing > Licenses: the E5 trial, Business Standard and the other trials with Available and Assigned counts
Open one product: the Users tab and the Groups tab show who holds it

screens.name: reclaim

steps: Between the Reclaim and the Restore commands: Microsoft 365 admin center > Users > Active users > riley.demo > Licenses and apps: the Dynamics trial is gone
After the Restore: refresh, it is back (licence changes can take a moment)
Show rollback.lab.json with skuId and user ids masked or cropped
mask: sku ids and user ids in the rollback file

screens.note: The reclaim plan covers every never-signed-in lab user holding the allowed trial SKU (riley.demo expected, possibly more); -Confirm:$false removes for all of them and -Restore puts all of them back. Run it only on lab accounts.

teardown: # by hand: compare each lab user's licences with series/LAB.md (E5, Entra ID Governance, Dynamics 365 Sales trial)
needs: trial:Microsoft 365 E5 (Entra ID P2 for signInActivity)
state:riley.demo and taylor.demo have never signed in
optional-not-defined:group-assigned duplicate licence (DuplicateDirectAndGroup) and Business Standard on sam.demo (not verified; skip if the service refuses)
